knowledge.title: Development Process Overview
knowledge.content: GrowthsStack.Dev follows a structured software development process consisting of Strategy, Architecture, Development, Deployment, and Support. The process is designed to deliver scalable, secure, and maintainable AI-powered software.

knowledge.title: Strategy Phase
knowledge.content: The project begins with understanding business goals, user requirements, existing systems, technical constraints, AI feasibility, data availability, integrations, timeline, and expected outcomes.

knowledge.title: Architecture Phase
knowledge.content: A technical architecture is planned including backend structure, database design, API architecture, authentication, cloud deployment strategy, AI integrations, scalability, security, and system workflows.

knowledge.title: Development Phase
knowledge.content: The solution is implemented using modern technologies such as Python, FastAPI, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, and AI APIs. Development follows clean architecture, modular code, version control, testing, and API-first principles.

knowledge.title: Testing & Quality Assurance
knowledge.content: Before deployment, the application is tested for functionality, API behavior, authentication, data validation, performance, security, and user experience. Bugs are resolved before release.

knowledge.title: Deployment Phase
knowledge.content: Applications are containerized using Docker and deployed to cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, Railway, Render, DigitalOcean, or VPS servers. Environment configuration, monitoring, backups, and logging are included where applicable.

knowledge.title: Support & Maintenance
knowledge.content: After deployment, ongoing support may include bug fixes, performance improvements, monitoring, updates, maintenance, and feature enhancements based on the agreed scope.

knowledge.title: Communication
knowledge.content: Clients receive regular progress updates throughout the project. Communication includes milestone reviews, demonstrations, feedback collection, and discussions about implementation decisions.

knowledge.title: AI Development Workflow
knowledge.content: For AI projects, the workflow includes problem definition, model selection, prompt design where applicable, knowledge preparation, RAG implementation if needed, integration, testing, and deployment.

knowledge.title: Project Completion
knowledge.content: The project is considered complete after agreed deliverables are implemented, tested, and delivered. Documentation and deployment guidance can be provided where included in the project scope.

faqs.question: How do you start a project?
faqs.answer: Every project begins with understanding your business goals, technical requirements, data sources, integrations, timeline, and desired outcomes.

faqs.question: What is your development process?
faqs.answer: The process includes Strategy, Architecture, Development, Testing, Deployment, and Support.

faqs.question: Do you plan the architecture before coding?
faqs.answer: Yes. System architecture, database design, APIs, authentication, scalability, and deployment strategy are planned before development.

faqs.question: Do you test the application?
faqs.answer: Yes. Functionality, APIs, authentication, performance, and security are tested before deployment.

faqs.question: How do you deploy applications?
faqs.answer: Applications are containerized with Docker and deployed to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, Railway, Render, DigitalOcean, or VPS servers.

faqs.question: Do you provide support after deployment?
faqs.answer: Yes. Post-launch support can include bug fixes, maintenance, monitoring, updates, and feature improvements based on the project agreement.

faqs.question: Do you provide project updates?
faqs.answer: Yes. Progress updates are shared through milestones, demos, and regular communication.

faqs.question: How do AI projects work?
faqs.answer: AI projects include requirement analysis, model selection, knowledge preparation, integration, testing, deployment, and optimization.

faqs.question: Can the process be customized?
faqs.answer: Yes. The development process can be adapted depending on the project's size, complexity, and business requirements.

faqs.question: Do you provide documentation?
faqs.answer: Documentation and deployment guidance can be provided if included in the project scope.
